site.name: Pet Health Decisions
site.tagline: Online vet visits, pet pharmacies, joint supplements and dog DNA tests - every fact read from the brand's own official page, with its source and check date.

brands.name: Vetster
brands.short_answer: Vetster is an online vet service with thousands of licensed veterinarians for video appointments and follow-up messaging. Its Vetster Plus subscription is $12/month billed annually and includes 4 same-day video appointments a year plus unlimited messaging with registered vet techs.
brands.price_condition: Billed annually; includes 4 same-day video appointments a year, 50% off additional bookings, carry-over of up to 2 unused appointments, unlimited messaging with registered vet techs, free standard shipping and 50% off pharmacy fees. Paying per appointment instead is also available at marketplace rates.

facts.fact: Vetster Plus costs $12/month, billed annually.
facts.condition: Vetster's own FAQ states billing occurs once per year; products and related fees are not included in the subscription.

facts.fact: Vetster Plus includes 4 same-day video appointments a year, 50% off additional bookings, and you can carry over up to 2 unused appointments to the next billing cycle.
facts.condition: Listed as subscription inclusions on the Vetster Plus page; the benefit can be shared by any pet in the home.

facts.fact: Both payment options - Vetster Plus and paying per appointment - include access to thousands of veterinarians, secure video calls, 48-hour follow-up live messaging with your vet, prescriptions through VetsterRx, and are available in all states.
facts.condition: Listed under 'Both payment options include' on the Vetster Plus page.

facts.fact: A single online veterinary appointment covers one pet only, is billed at marketplace rates, and the Vetster Plus page prints it as 'Starting at $102 one-time'.
facts.condition: Quoted verbatim from the 'Per appointment' column of Vetster's Plus page; marketplace rates are set per veterinarian, so the price you see at booking is what governs.

facts.fact: VetsterRx standard shipping (2-3 business days, 3pm EST cut-off) is free for Vetster Plus members and for non-member orders over $45; express shipping (1-2 business days) is $19 for both.
facts.condition: Fee table on the VetsterRx page; refrigerated items ship express only, Monday-Thursday, and orders after the cut-off ship the next business day.

facts.fact: VetsterRx charges a pharmacy fee of $7 per order for Vetster Plus members and $14 for non-members, and a compounding fee of $10 for members and $20 for non-members.
facts.condition: Per-order fee table on the VetsterRx page; the pharmacy fee covers verifying and fulfilling each new order.

facts.fact: Vetster vets treat 20+ species, including birds, horses, reptiles, hamsters, rabbits and other pocket pets.
facts.condition: Stated in Vetster's own treatment navigation for all species.

faqs.a: Vetster Plus is $12/month, billed annually, and includes 4 video appointments a year plus unlimited messaging with a certified veterinary professional. If you pay per appointment instead, the single appointment is billed at marketplace rates and the Vetster Plus page prints it as 'Starting at $102 one-time'.

faqs.q: Is Vetster available in my state?
faqs.a: Vetster states that both Vetster Plus and per-appointment payment options are available in all states, and that appointments are with licensed veterinarians.

faqs.q: Can an online vet on Vetster prescribe medication?
faqs.a: Vetster states its veterinarians can prescribe online: the vet may decide your pet needs a prescription during the appointment, you add the medication to your cart in the app, and you order it through VetsterRx or pick it up from your local pharmacy. Prescriptions are available in select states.

faqs.q: How much are VetsterRx pharmacy and shipping fees?
faqs.a: Pharmacy fee per order is $7 for Vetster Plus members and $14 for non-members; the compounding fee is $10 for members and $20 for non-members. Standard shipping is free for members and for non-member orders over $45, while express shipping is $19.
Vetster's FAQ says you may cancel your subscription at any time, but the membership must be canceled before it renews to avoid the next billing cycle.

brands.name: 1-800-PetMeds
brands.short_answer: 1-800-PetMeds sells prescription and non-prescription pet medication online. It requires a veterinarian's approval before shipping prescription items, ships free on orders over $49 with standard delivery in 2-5 business days, and gives AutoShip orders 5% off future orders.
brands.price_condition: Standard delivery in 2-5 business days, as stated in the shipping banner on 1800petmeds.com; for prescription items a veterinarian's approval is required before shipment.

facts.fact: Free shipping on orders over $49, with standard delivery in 2-5 business days.
facts.condition: Shipping banner on 1800petmeds.com; the same banner notes that for prescription items vet approval is required before shipment.

facts.fact: For prescription items, a veterinarian's approval is required before shipment, and the site says it will reach out to your veterinarian for prescription approval before shipping.
facts.condition: Prescription workflow shown in the site's own cart and AutoShip messaging; your vet's response time affects delivery.

facts.fact: AutoShip orders lock in 5% off future orders, and an email is sent one week before an AutoShip order ships so you can make changes; orders can be skipped or paused online.
facts.condition: AutoShip program description on 1800petmeds.com; certain products or categories may not be eligible for discounts, and discounts are shown on product pages.

facts.fact: While enrolled in AutoShip you can schedule a free video call with a licensed vet.
facts.condition: Listed as an AutoShip benefit on 1800petmeds.com; the benefit is tied to being enrolled in AutoShip.

facts.fact: 1-800-PetMeds runs a price match: 'See a lower price somewhere? We'll match it!', with a 100% satisfaction guarantee.
facts.condition: You contact the company with the lower price you found and it verifies the price before matching.

facts.fact: A promotion shown on the site offers 20% off select supplements with code SUP20, with savings of up to $20 per order.
facts.condition: Promotion banner displayed on 1800petmeds.com on 2026-09-25; promotion terms apply and the offer can change or end.

faqs.q: Do I need a prescription to order medication from 1-800-PetMeds?
faqs.a: For prescription items, yes: the site states that a veterinarian's approval is required before shipment and that it reaches out to your veterinarian for prescription approval before shipping.

faqs.q: How fast is 1-800-PetMeds shipping and how much does it cost?
faqs.a: Standard delivery is 2-5 business days and shipping is free on orders over $49, according to the shipping banner on the site.

AutoShip is the recurring order program: you lock in 5% off future orders, get an email one week before each order ships, can skip or pause online, and can schedule a free video call with a licensed vet while enrolled.
Yes - the site says 'See a lower price somewhere? We'll match it!' and asks you to contact them so they can verify the lower price, backed by a 100% satisfaction guarantee.

faqs.q: Is there a discount code on the official site right now?
faqs.a: On 2026-09-25 the site displayed 20% off select supplements with code SUP20, with savings of up to $20 per order. Promotion terms apply and offers change, so check the banner on 1800petmeds.com before ordering.

brands.name: Cosequin
brands.short_answer: Cosequin is Nutramax's joint supplement line for dogs, cats and horses. The brand calls itself the #1 veterinarian recommended retail joint health supplement, publishes over 25 formulas, and says more than 80 quality checks are run per batch.
brands.price_line: Not published on the official site
brands.price_condition: Cosequin's own site lists its products and shows a Where to Buy CTA instead of prices, so the price you pay is set by the retailer you buy from.

facts.fact: Cosequin describes itself as the #1 veterinarian recommended retail joint health supplement brand.
facts.condition: Site states the survey was conducted among small animal veterinarians who recommended oral joint health supplements, counting retail brands only.

facts.fact: Cosequin says it has over 25 unique formulas to meet the specific needs of a dog, cat or horse.
facts.condition: Figure published on Cosequin's homepage; product formats listed on the site include soft chews, chewable tablets, sprinkle capsules, tidbits, pellets, powder and tablets.

facts.fact: Cosequin says over 80 quality checks are conducted per batch of product.
facts.condition: Quality figure published on Cosequin's homepage.

facts.fact: Cosequin says it has received over 100,000 5-star ratings on Amazon and Chewy.
facts.condition: Self-reported figure on Cosequin's homepage; the ratings themselves live on the two retailer sites.

facts.fact: Cosequin says it has provided joint health support for over 25 years with operations based in the U.S., and its page banner reads 'Over 30 Years of Unmatched Quality'.
facts.condition: Both figures appear on cosequin.com (product stat and page banner) and are reproduced here as published.

facts.fact: Cosequin's official site publishes no prices: the homepage lists products and a Where to Buy call to action instead of price figures.
facts.condition: Checked on the homepage on 2026-09-25; no price figures were listed, so prices must be read at the retailer.

faqs.a: Cosequin is a joint supplement line from Nutramax for dogs, cats and horses. Cosequin's site says the #1 veterinarian recommended retail joint health supplement contains ingredients backed by scientific research and is available in a variety of formulas to support joint health.
Dogs, cats and horses - Cosequin publishes separate product lines for each, with formats that include soft chews, chewable tablets, sprinkle capsules, tidbits, pellets, powder and tablets.

Cosequin states it is the #1 veterinarian recommended retail joint health supplement brand, based on a survey conducted among small animal veterinarians who recommended oral joint health supplements, counting retail brands only.

Cosequin's official site does not publish prices - it lists the products and points shoppers to a Where to Buy option, so the price is set by the retailer. Compare the per-serving size of the formula you pick when you check retailers.

brands.name: Embark
brands.short_answer: Embark's Breed + Health dog DNA test is listed at $139 and screens for 270+ genetic health conditions, traits and allergy risk scores, with results in 2-4 weeks. Shipping within the US is free with a pre-paid mailer.
brands.price_condition: List price shown on Embark's product page on 2026-09-25; the Breed ID Dog DNA Test and the Dog Age Test are listed at $109 each. Sales and promotions change the displayed price.

facts.fact: Embark lists the Breed + Health dog DNA test at $139, the Breed ID Dog DNA Test at $109 and the Dog Age Test at $109.
facts.condition: Add-to-cart prices displayed on Embark's product pages on 2026-09-25; the site also runs a banner promoting the Breed + Health test at $139.

facts.fact: Breed + Health includes screening for 270+ genetic health conditions, traits and Allergy Risk Scores, while Breed ID covers breed mix, ancestry and relatives only.
facts.condition: Stated in the product FAQ answering 'How is this different from the Breed ID Test?'.

facts.fact: Results are delivered in 2-4 weeks, and Embark's FAQ says results are typically ready within a few weeks of your sample arriving at the lab.
facts.condition: Step 3 of the product instructions plus the product FAQ; Embark emails you when results are ready.

facts.fact: Shipping is free within the US with a pre-paid mailer; samples remain stable for 6 months but tests expire 2 years after purchase.
facts.condition: Step 2 of the instructions on the product page - activate each test online and return the sample by mail.

facts.fact: The sample is collected by swabbing the inside of the cheek pouch and under the tongue for at least 30 seconds.
facts.condition: Step 1 of Embark's instructions on the product page.

facts.fact: Embark says it is a research partner of Cornell University College of Veterinary Medicine, with one of the world's largest dog DNA databases.
facts.condition: Answer in the product FAQ 'How is Embark different from other dog DNA tests?'.

facts.fact: The test reports on 55 physical traits, including size, coat color and grooming needs.
facts.condition: Listed under the physical traits section of the product page.

faqs.q: How much does an Embark dog DNA test cost?
faqs.a: The Breed + Health test is listed at $139, while the Breed ID Dog DNA Test and the Dog Age Test are listed at $109 each, as shown on Embark's product pages on 2026-09-25. Promotions change the displayed price.

faqs.q: How long do Embark results take?
faqs.a: Results come back in 2-4 weeks according to the product instructions, and Embark's FAQ adds that they are typically ready within a few weeks of your sample arriving at the lab - you are notified by email.

faqs.q: Is a DNA test worth it if my dog seems healthy?
faqs.a: Embark's FAQ answers that genetic health risks do not always show symptoms right away, so testing early means you and your vet can watch for a risk before it becomes a bigger problem.

faqs.q: What happens if my Embark results show a health risk?
faqs.a: Embark says you get a clear explanation of what the result means along with next steps to bring to your vet, and notes that genetic testing is an assessment of risk, not a diagnosis.

faqs.q: How is Embark different from other dog DNA tests?
faqs.a: Embark says it is a research partner of Cornell University College of Veterinary Medicine with one of the world's largest dog DNA databases, and that Breed + Health adds 270+ genetic health condition screening, traits and Allergy Risk Scores on top of breed mix and ancestry.

home_faqs.q: Can a veterinarian see my pet online?
home_faqs.a: Yes - Vetster lets you book video appointments with licensed veterinarians 24/7 and says both its subscription and per-appointment options are available in all states. Both options include secure video calls, 48-hour follow-up live messaging with your vet, and access to thousands of veterinarians.

home_faqs.q: How do online pet pharmacies handle prescription medication?
home_faqs.a: 1-800-PetMeds states that for prescription items a veterinarian's approval is required before shipment and that it reaches out to your veterinarian for approval before shipping. Vetster works differently: its vet decides during your appointment whether a prescription is needed, and you order it through VetsterRx or pick it up at a local pharmacy.

home_faqs.q: How much does shipping cost when I order pet medication online?
home_faqs.a: On the brands' own published figures: 1-800-PetMeds gives free shipping on orders over $49 with standard delivery in 2-5 business days, and VetsterRx standard shipping is free for Vetster Plus members and for non-member orders over $45, with express shipping at $19.

home_faqs.q: How much does a dog DNA test cost?
home_faqs.a: Embark lists its Breed + Health dog DNA test at $139, while the Breed ID Dog DNA Test and the Dog Age Test are listed at $109 each (prices shown on 2026-09-25). Breed + Health adds screening for 270+ genetic health conditions, traits and Allergy Risk Scores, with results in 2-4 weeks.

home_faqs.q: Are joint supplements for dogs backed by anything?
home_faqs.a: Cosequin says its formulas contain ingredients backed by scientific research and that over 80 quality checks are run per batch; it also states it is the #1 veterinarian recommended retail joint health supplement brand, based on a survey among small animal veterinarians who recommended oral joint health supplements, counting retail brands only.
